title: The Plugins page's title, and the first crumb of a plugin's admin page. A plugin is a feature an admin installs on this instance.
crumb-fallback: Crumb of a plugin's admin page while its name isn't known yet.
open: Button that opens an installed plugin.
load-failed: Error toast when the list of plugins could not load.
update-failed: Error toast when installing, enabling, disabling or changing a plugin failed.
update-to: Badge or button: a newer version of the plugin is in the catalog. {{version}} is its version, like 1.3.0.
meta: Line under a plugin's name: {{author}} is who made it, {{version}} its version. The "removed" form adds that the catalog no longer lists it.
no-permissions: What a plugin asks for when it asks for no permissions.
permission-sentence: One permission as a sentence, in a line of them. {{permission}} is one of the permissions (permissions.*), or a scope's technical name.
permissions.social-read: What the plugin permission social:read lets it do.
permissions.social-write: What the plugin permission social:write lets it do.
permissions.calendar-read: What the plugin permission calendar:read lets it do.
permissions.calendar-write: What the plugin permission calendar:write lets it do.
permissions.person-read: What the plugin permission person:read lets it do. Socio is the product's name.
audience.admins: Choice of who can use an installed plugin: the workspace's admins only.
audience.members: Choice of who can use an installed plugin: every member of the workspace, admins included.
display.inside: Badge: the plugin's page shows inside Socio (the product), in a frame.
display.tab: Badge: the plugin's page opens in a new browser tab.
mode.bundled: Badge: the plugin runs inside Socio (the product) itself.
mode.service: Badge: the plugin runs as a separate service (a container) beside Socio.
run.disabled: Badge: an admin turned the plugin off.
run.running: Badge: how many copies (replicas) of the plugin's service run. {{running}} run now, out of {{count}}.
run.stopped: Badge: the plugin's service is stopped.
run.starting: Badge: the plugin's service is starting.
backup-badge.not_backed_up: Badge: the plugin keeps data on its own storage that the workspace's backups don't include.
backup-badge.failing: Badge: the plugin's last backup failed.
backup-badge.stale: Badge: the plugin's last good backup is old.
storage-warning.not-backed-up: Badge in the catalog before install: the plugin's storage won't be backed up.
storage-warning.private: Badge in the catalog before install: the plugin keeps data on its own storage, which the workspace can't read.
storage-warning.message: The catalog's own explanation beside that badge, as a sentence. {{message}} comes from the catalog, in English.
sensitive.badge: Badge before a permission that needs care.
sensitive.open-any-https: What the plugin permission bridge.openAnyHttps lets it do. https is a protocol; keep it. The manifest is the plugin's description file.
